notes:
# v1.3.24 — Account sign-in panel skeleton

- New: when you first open the Account tab, the Account (sign-in) panel now
  shows shimmer placeholders while your sign-in state loads, instead of
  briefly flashing the sign-in form. It then reveals "Signed in as …" with
  your level, or the sign-in form if you are signed out.
- The placeholder appears only on the first load of the Account tab per
  session; later refreshes (signing in or out, syncing) update silently with
  no skeleton flash.
- If the account service cannot be reached, the placeholder is cleared and the
  panel falls back to its normal content — nothing is left shimmering.
- Fixed: the account panel's data now finishes loading before the shimmer is
  removed, so the sign-in state no longer appears a moment after the skeleton
  disappears.
- No other behaviour changed.
